desc: Ideation: derive f(a+b) = (a+b)/2^v2(a+b); partition pairs by k = v2(a+b); condition v2(a+b)=k ⟺ a+b ≡ 2^k (mod 2^{k+1}); verified formula on sample 1 (1+3+1=5).

Design memory-safe hybrid: residue-array method for k ≤ 20 (modulus ≤ 2^21, ~34MB), candidate-sum enumeration for k = 21..24 (≤ 9 candidate sums via distinct values); int64 overflow analysis (max ~8e17 < 2^63); diagonal handling (k=0: D=0; k≥1: r ≡ 2^{k-1} mod 2^k).
Write final Python+numpy code (fast input, bincount per k, distinct-value candidate counting, accumulate answer).

Verify code against all three samples by hand/trace, check edge cases (N=1, uniform values, small maxA triggering only residue path, lazy cnt0 construction) — samples 1 and 2 traced exactly (5, 384), sample 3 boundary k=20 confirmed, candidate path logic verified, overflow/precision and memory (~110MB) confirmed safe.
